units.source_text: 薰中纳言对侍女有时也戏作风情之言，有时召唤她们到身边来服侍。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, would sometimes speak playfully and charmingly to the waiting women, and sometimes call them to his side to attend on him.

units.source_text: 此等侍女之中，自然也有楚楚可观之人。

en.t: Among these waiting women, there were naturally some who were graceful and pleasing to look at.

units.source_text: 但他真正倾心相爱的一个也没有，都是清清白白的。

en.t: But there was not a single one whom he truly loved with all his heart; his relations with them were entirely innocent.

units.source_text: 再者，有些女子身份并不低于宇治两女公子，只因时势移变，家道衰微，生涯孤苦无依。

en.t: Moreover, some women were of no lower rank than the two young ladies of Uji, but changing times had brought their families into decline, leaving them to live lonely and unsupported lives.

units.source_text: 这些女子被找寻出来，派在三条宫邸供职的，为数甚多。

en.t: Many such women had been sought out and assigned to serve at the Sanjo residence.

units.source_text: 但薰中纳言坚贞自守，从不沾惹她们。

en.t: But Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, kept himself firmly restrained and never became involved with them.

units.source_text: 因为他深恐有了恋爱之人，将来出家离世之时受到羁绊。

en.t: For he deeply feared that if he had someone he loved, she would become a hindrance when he later renounced the world and left secular life behind.

units.source_text: 现在却为了宇治女公子而如此受苦，他自己也觉得乖戾。

en.t: Yet now he was suffering so much for the young lady of Uji that even he felt it was contrary and unreasonable.

units.source_text: 有一晚，由于想念此事，比平常更难入睡，不眠直到早晨。

en.t: One night, because he kept thinking about this, he found it even harder than usual to fall asleep and lay awake until morning.

units.source_text: 但见晓雾笼罩的篱内，各种花卉开得非常美丽，其中夹杂着短命的朝颜，特别惹人注目。

en.t: He saw that within the fence, wrapped in dawn mist, all kinds of flowers were blooming beautifully, and among them the short-lived morning glories especially drew the eye.

units.source_text: 古歌云：“天明花发艳，转瞬即凋零。”

en.t: An old poem says, "At daybreak the flowers bloom in beauty, only to wither in an instant."

units.source_text: 此花象征人世无常，令人看了不胜感慨。

en.t: This flower seemed to symbolize the impermanence of human life, and the sight of it filled one with deep emotion.

units.source_text: 他昨夜不曾关上格子窗，略微躺卧一会儿天就亮了，故此花开时，只有他一人看见。

en.t: The night before, he had not closed the lattice shutters, and after lying down only briefly, dawn had come; therefore, when the flowers opened, he alone saw them.

units.source_text: 他就呼唤侍臣，对他们说：“今天我要到北院去，替我准备车子，排场不可太大。”

en.t: He called his attendants and said to them, "Today I am going to the northern residence. Prepare a carriage for me, but do not make the arrangements too grand."

units.source_text: 侍臣答道：“亲王昨日入宫值宿去了，昨夜随从人等带了空车回来的。”

en.t: The attendants replied, "The prince went to the palace yesterday for overnight duty, and last night his followers brought back the empty carriage."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“亲王虽不在家，但夫人患病，我要去探望。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "Although the prince is not at home, his wife is ill, so I must go visit her.

units.source_text: 今天是入宫的日子，我须在日高之前回来。”

en.t: Today is the day I go to the palace, so I must return before the sun is high."

units.source_text: 便准备装束。

en.t: He then prepared his attire.

units.source_text: 出门之时，信步下阶，在花草中小立。

en.t: When he was about to leave, he casually descended the steps and stood for a moment among the flowers and grasses.

units.source_text: 虽不故意装出风流潇洒之姿态，却令人一看就觉得异常高尚优雅而不得不退避三舍，

en.t: Although he did not deliberately assume an elegant and romantic air, one glance made him seem so extraordinarily noble and refined that people could not help drawing back in awe,

units.source_text: 与那种装腔作势的好色之徒截然不同，自有一种优美的神情。

en.t: and he was utterly unlike those affected libertines, possessing a natural grace of expression all his own.

units.source_text: 他想摘朝颜花，把花蔓拉过来，露珠纷纷滴下。

en.t: He tried to pick a morning glory, and as he drew the vine toward him, drops of dew fell one after another.

units.source_text: 遂独吟云：

en.t: Then he softly recited to himself:
